observations.classification: source-backed current revisit of historical CAMERA-ADM03-F004, not a new independent finding
observations.condition: An otherwise valid item of a kind whose capabilities are required omits the entire capabilities field.
observations.trace: The current outer item validator invokes validate_capabilities only when the field is present; inside that function repairable kinds require durability, food requires food metadata, and container requires container metadata. The current typed ItemDefinition defaults the absent field to Capabilities, whose derived Default contains optional members. Thus, the required-kind checks are skipped for field omission and the typed default does not itself restore them. This is a static conditional admission gap on the shown route; no example catalog, fixture, validator, build, product, or consumer ran. Other required fields and any alternative semantic gates must be accounted for before claiming a runtime effect.

This current source revisit does not assert an automatic ledger alias or duplicate increment; central reconciliation owns disposition.
observations.future_repair_direction: After audit and authorization, enforce required kind/capability relations at the canonical admission boundary even when the outer field is omitted, while preserving legitimately optional capabilities for other kinds; trace other constructors and consumers first.
